anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved f1 and f3 to holds by routing the unchanged `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` helper result through the Exit check before any watch, rendering verdict `stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff`, and using the obstacle template (deliver, assess, stop recommended last, no wait/fix rows, evidence in a hint); Before instead reported `fixable - 1 blocker` with ordinary wait/fix/review rows and fix recommended, so it never exited as a concrete needs obstacle. f2 held in both since neither ran a watch or redispatched the helper. Two things in After weaken the last clause of f3 and should be tightened in the template: the deliver row bundles a cap extension (`add 6 to each cap`, to 12/12) even though usage is 1 of 6 with nothing exhausted, which reads as if extension were the remedy; and it says `no round charged` for a retry that would produce new source commits. Keep the row as `deliver - resume the retained course; authorizes the src/guard.ts edit outside the diff for P1; a retry without that grant repeats the obstacle; caps unchanged (rounds 1 of 6, syncs 0 of 6)` so the text itself states that extension alone cannot clear the prerequisite and that only the course pick granting the out-of-diff edit does.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After moves all three facts in the intended direction: it reads the retained `open - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` result, names it an unchanged missing prerequisite, and has the Exit check select `stuck - needs src/guard.ts outside the diff` before any watch, repair, sync, push or spent round; the menu then offers numeric deliver and assess with stop recommended and last, no fix/wait rows, and evidence only as a hint, while the deliver row ties resumption to the prerequisite changing rather than to the cap extension. Before never reached an obstacle at all—it rendered `fixable`, kept an ordinary `wait` row, recommended `fix`, and framed `course: deliver` as granting no repair authority, so the failed prerequisite never surfaced as a needs obstacle. Two small wording risks in After to tighten: the deliver row at 1/6 rounds still advertises `add 6 to each cap` even though no cap is exhausted, which could read as an invented extension; consider conditioning the extension text on exhausted usage, and phrase the row as 'deliver - resume the retained course once src/guard.ts outside the diff is supplied (extension alone does not clear this)' so the 'extension cannot clear the prerequisite' point is explicit rather than implied.
